subject: The feature we built at 3AM
preview_text: You heard it here first — a game-changer for your date nights. See what's coming.
body_paragraphs: At 3AM last Tuesday, our co-founder sent a voice memo that still gives me chills. It was about a couple who'd been together 8 years, stuck in the same restaurant loop, and the wife whispered, 'I just want him to see me again.' That moment broke something in us. We realized our app could do more than suggest dates — it could make your partner feel truly seen, like the first time.

You're part of a small group getting this early look. Starting next week, SoulPlan will introduce a feature that turns a simple date plan into a 'thought of you tonight' full-screen experience — no bare notification, just a cinematic moment that says, 'I chose you again.' Plus, a community of couples where you can share your wins and get inspired by others, all moderated so it stays safe and supportive.

This is the sneak peek no one else sees yet. When your partner opens your date, they'll feel that spark — proof that you're still paying attention. It's the gesture that costs nothing but means everything, and it's built right into Tonight's Date.

Tap SoulPlan now and open the home screen. See your couple identity — you and your partner — and imagine what tomorrow will look like. P.S. The first 50 couples who use the new feature get early access to the anniversaries jar — no forgetting ever again.
